reviews.comment: I did well in this class but I HATED going. so degrading poor feedback yelled at us a lot very opinionated if you disagreed with his views i made it through but i did not enjoy this class one bit
My favorite professor at TAMU. So funny. He understands but also holds his students to a standard. Super great guy just don't be a major slacker. Show up and engage but hes great.

Yes it is an easy A but it is absolutely not worth it. He gives little instruction and then takes off heavy on assignments because if you so much as word the correct answer differently than he had it in his head he will tell you that you're wrong. Asks invading questions that are unnecessary to be funny and is disrespectful.

Anyone complaining about Dr. Lemmons just doesn't want to be a college student. He is funny and engaging every class period. Concepts are easy to grasp and made to be fun. He is definitely going to ask you to participate so be ready. I have never felt more at home than in Dr. Lemmons class. He is a true gem of education. Take his class!!!

Yells often and is not enjoyable to listen to. His humor involves degrading students. Extremely easy class, easy A if you put in any effort whatsoever. If you want to take this class for an easy grade, you'd be better off taking another easy class with a prof who isn't frankly rude.

I would take him again if I really had too, but I didn't like his class at all. He randomly grades tough, even though he never provides a rubric and doesn't give any direction for assignments. His tests are online and open book. He randomly yells at people in class and its super uncomfortable. Sit with good ppl on the 1st day bc group projects.

It will be easy to get an A in this class but attendance is MANDATORY and he kind of just bullies everyone the whole class period. I don't think I really learned anything but all tests are online and open book so take if you want an easy A.

Easily one of the worst profs I've had at tamu, do not take him. He is rude and a tough grader when he shouldn't be because he gives 0 instructions and no rubric for any assignment. Had to fight for my A. At least 5/8 people need to be in class, but class is worthless because you don't learn anything for exams or assignments. Terrible professor!!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was so unorganized and the professor was a little shocking. There was a syllabus explaining the layout for your grade, but absolutely no rubric for the group projects, which he would take off at least 10 points every time and provide no feedback. Only 4 people in your group had to attend class and tests were online.

I thought prof was pretty funny. My complaint is that tests were unrelated to class completely. Things came directly out of the textbook, and 90% of the time we did not cover any of it. I felt unprepared every time. Lots of presentations as well, which wasn't my personal favorite, but I understand the need for them in this class.

ALL of your grades are group grades and you will be with the same people the whole semester. His teaching style is stressful and often incoherent, he spends the whole time yelling at people (not exaggerating). Rubrics for these group projects are at times unclear, and his grading is unnecessarily tough. The one benefit is that it is minimal work.
He picks too much at his students. He doesn't provide a rubric; basically just grades by how he's feeling.  Spends class insulting students rather than teaching lectures.

The majority of your grade is determined by three solo speeches and one group speech. His grading is a little weird and subjective, but so long as you include what he tells you to include during the lectures in your speeches you'll get an easy A. He likes to mess with and banter with his students (especially the football players), so get ready.

If you want a pretty easy A, definitely take this class. I would take it again for a good grade. However, be ready to have a professor who is very obnoxious and calls on students randomly every single class. He likes to just ramble on about various topics from lectures and you will have majority group work.
Overall, I would recommend for an easy A.

You have exams almost every other week. Group projects matter a lot and you get your groups attendance. Very bad at giving directions for projects. Exams are open note and can be taken at home and answers are easy to find. Don't look at him in class if you don't want to get called on. Easy class overall just put effort.

Larry is a very interesting guy. He basically questions students about random things the whole time. One time he asked people about their love lives for the entire class. He is very biased politics wise. If you don't want to feel like your sitting in a woke class don't take him. Very group project heavy so sit by good people the first day.

Material made us critically think but was very biased. Projects were on philosophers from class but most had strange ideology. Class is disorganized, no rubrics, no Canvas organization, & complex instructions. He has favorites to pick on, so if you dislike that, avoid looking at him. Your group will make or break your grade, so communicate.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are looking for a class to show up, do work for other classes, and get your A, Larry is the guy for you. If you want to learn or have a political opinion that is not in line with CNN, don't take this class.

Professor Lemmons is one of the best teachers I have had at A&M. He is funny and keeps the class entertaining by talking about current day events. The class is group attendance based and the tests are open resource. He is very knowledgeable about journalism and media and is very moderate. TAKE THIS CLASS!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: While the class may pose itself as an easy class, the professor lacks structure and clear direction with assignments. Your grade will be based on how much he is feelings that day. He does not grade with a rubric so your grade in the class is like the roll of a dice. This class is not worth the time nor the money.

Best Prof ever! Took him for COMM 434 last semester & he genuinely cares for his students if you put the work in. He will call you out in class, but never with bad intentions. Will change grade if you revise your paper within a week. He can ramble sometimes, but lectures are enjoyable & its a fairly easy A. Would take him over and over again!

The class consists of weekly group projects (easy and graded leniently), one individual project (interviewing someone from another country), and open note online exams (textbook and slides have the answers). Only 3 of the people in your group need to be there for attendance. Lectures are interesting but not necessary. He WILL call on you.

He's understanding, super nice, funny, and chill. It's 80% group stuff so be careful who you choose to be in a group with!!! Other than that it's easy. Only 5/8 of your group members have to show up to lectures to be counted present and given credit for the day. Lectures are interesting and warning: he WILL pick on you to answer and share ur POV.

Larry was a great professor! Very nice guy and the setup of the class is great! Groups of 8, and only 5 have to show per class. Mainly graded on group projects and exams and they're all very easy. One individual paper and one final paper that can be done in groups of 4, is not bad at all. Take this professor!!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class, your grade depends on who you sit by in class on the first day. Only 5/8 members need to be in class each day, but you relied on these people for group projects. He randomly gave me a harsh grade on a project but for the most part was an easy grader... don't expect feedback and not a class if you really want to learn, just an easy A

He is very blunt but a good professor. Everyone is assigned a group, and only half have to go to class every day. All exams are open note/book. He requires a textbook, but you really don't need it. There are 4 group projects, 5 exams, 1 individual project, and a final. His lectures are very engaging, and he expects his students to participate.

I loved Professor Lemmons. He is so funny and makes an effort to talk to everyone in class. He knew my name and asked me questions by the second week, which I enjoy as an extravert. All of class was just discussion and conversation. There was no homework, easy online tests, and fun group presentations or papers. He is great!

He calls on students and doesn't even ask a real nor relevant question. The whole semester you're “learning” about theorist but he talks about them for a total of 10 min the whole course. He claims that the students don't put enough effort in but doesn't even give rubrics for the projects so prepared to be confused. Someone has got to humble him.

The entire class is basically one big group project. Be wise with who you sit with as those will be your partners for the rest of the semester. You WILL have to present in front of the class. I do not recommend this class to people with social anxiety, as he calls on at least everyone once. Tests are taken online and are open book/friend. Easy A

The class itself is extremely easy, although he switched up on the grading this semester. There are group projects but no rubric, and he takes points off for unclear reasons.  He likes to be "sarcastic," but it can come off as just plain mean. He likes to call on people randomly in class, so be prepared to answer his questions.

Whoever rates this prof a 1 either can't quickly form a single coherent thought or needs their hand held through every assignment/topic. Lectures are great and prompt difficult conversations that people are probably too sheltered to have. Test answers come straight from the textbook, probably the easiest comm class I've ever taken.

BARF! He is so belittling it makes me sick. Lectures are pointless bc nothing he says is on the exams. He loves to just listen to himself talk he calls out students and when they attempt to answer his absurd question the student is wrong. He will interrupt and yell at you. My class usually answers with "idk" my guess into why is bc they're scared.

He was the worst professor I have ever taken a class with. He is straight rude to his students and takes joy in demeaning and judging them. The workload is not hard but the rubrics for the projects he assigns, are very vague, and we have to figure most of it out. He will call people out and force them to give him an answer. He also barely teaches.

He is the rudest professor I have ever taken in my four years at this university. His passive-aggressive nature makes this class unbearable to sit through. Larry prides himself on being a progressive man, but in truth, he makes misogynistic, classist, and borderline racist comments during his lectures. Easy class, but be prepared to be screamed at.

Dr. Lemmons is an amazing professor. He has a personality that is very different from most professors. He constantly makes jokes and tries to get students to think outside of the box. Class is odd, but enjoyable. I highly recommend taking his course, but if you don't mesh with his teaching style or like him, you probably should not take him.

You can tell he loves to learn about people, and letting other people learn about them. He was definitely more than just a "public speaking" teacher. I learned a lot of life lessons in that class and genuinely learned information thats useful outside of school. I wish I could take him again! One of my favorite classes ever.

He's honestly super rude and I don't remember him ever actually teaching. He's super passive aggressive and will specifically call students out.
It is an easy A, but there aren't many assignments, so if you miss one thing, it'll tank your grade.
The textbook is required, because all the exam stuff comes straight from that and not from class.

This class is an easy A, however be prepared for constant attacks and passive agressive remarks. He makes you come to class for no reason, just to listen to him talk for 50 minutes. Not fun at all, but easy A.
Take COMM 365 with Professor Lemmons. He is not the nicest professor, but it is a very simple class. Lots of group work and lectures, nothing bad at all.

This was the third class I've taken w Lemmons and he is always the best. Class was a lot of group discussion and watching videos but attendance wasn't mandatory. Class material is super interesting and I learned a lot without having to be stressed ab the class. Definitely recommend, esp for anyone going into the political realm.

Dr. Lemmons is one of the best professors at A&M! He really cares about what he teaches and really wants us to learn. JOUR450, Political Reporting, is a great class to take if you want to learn more about political journalism. We take weekly quizzes on current events and write papers, or news stories. TAKE HIM!

Class is very easy, just read all of the other comments. The professor might not be everyones "cup of tea," but in my opinion, he is one of the greatest professors at this university. His personality provides an environment where you cant do much else but laugh, but make sure not to leave class in the middle or early without telling him before.....

Dr Lemmons can be pretty rude and impatient with people. He never personally said anything bad to me but I watched him give backhanded comments plenty of times and never really sounded too caring to me. The class is very easy though. Tests are open book/open internet and you can work on them in groups. Group projects are also simple.

Dr. Lemmons is a very funny & knowledgeable prof! 

Attendance policy was the same group majority others have written about. He asks VERY thought-provoking questions about lectures in class, & will sometimes call people out if no one responds. Very easy group projects & tests. I barely had work for this course I couldn't complete in-class.

Class and assignments are all easy. Groups are assigned on the first day and are who you will work with for the rest of the semester. There are textbook readings, but all exams are open note and open book. Even though class was easy, I wouldnt take him again because he likes to call on students/groups, which can create an uncomfortable environment.

Dr. Lemmons is the best! I have taken him for two classes and I love him. Work load is really light and every project but one is a group project. I learned so much and it was fun. His class set up is great and you never really need to worry about failing. Couldn't recommend him more!

Easiest A you will ever get. Definitely take this class for your international communications credit! You will get in groups day 1 and only 4/6 group members need to come each day. So you can rotate with your group and get days off. Every assignment can be done in class, in like 10 minutes. On days I did go I just treated it as a study hall.

Professor Lemmons made this class very easy. You are put into groups at the beginning of the semester and at least 4 people had to be present from your group for each class in order to be counted for attendance (we had a group of 8). He doesn't like when people disagree with him/ can go off on tangents a lot, but it was an easy class.

Highly recommend you take this class if you need an A and want to learn about pop culture. All you have to do for the class is to do your group projects and participate in class. You might need the textbook for tests, but as long as one person in your group has it you will be good. Professor Lemmons is very approachable if you need anything.

TAKE HIS CLASS! One of the easiest classes ever, he just wants us to learn about the material. He is hilarious and very approachable. All you have to do is to do group projects and participate in class. You might need the text book for the tests, but the tests can be taken with your group so as long as one of you has it you'll be good.

I loved Larry his class was very laidback. Honestly make sure you have your textbook because nothing on the tests is put on the lectures, mainly because he just talks and jokes the whole time. Regardless, the tests are open note so just get one and youll be fine. If you can, take this prof for any class, easiest A at A&M

You work in groups and are graded by whether your group shows up so make sure to pick a good group the first day. He would get upset if you questioned him but as long as you do what he says and your group is there, you will do great. The information was very easy, you can take the tests in groups, and group presentations were pretty easy.

Super easy class! Everything is or can be done in a group. He wants you to get an A, he says grades are dumb haha. He is fairly understanding, just communicate with him if you have any questions, he wants to help the best he can. I highly recommend talking him as a professor if you can.
Professor Lemmons is an awesome guy! definitely worth taking if you can. Very group focused class with only 1 paper that is induvial. attendance is mandatory but only once a week with your group.

He made attendance mandatory once a week, instead of twice a week. The group projects were not hard, the only real work from this class was the group paper at the end of the semester, but everyone's grade is so high that no one is stressed about it. He is hilarious and has interactive lectures that can go any direction that the students want it to.

Professor Lemmons was one of the chillest teachers Ive ever met. He was always honest and treated you like a friend. He was super understanding of situations and backed up his students if they needed help or had issues. He was a very funny guy and he picks on people too have a chill work environment. He might pick on u but u can pick on him back
Super cool and chill prof. Group project heavy, but they are aren't hard at all. Open book and group tests. All around easy class. 10/10

He'll put you into groups and you'll decide who comes for the class. He engages his students into the lecture. All of the grades are group work so you should make sure you get a good group. He will give As on presentations, he just likes to hear you talk and get imaginative in what you're talking about.

Amazing professor who genuinely cares about his students. Most of the assignments are group projects but as long as you participate, you don't have to present. Made sure everyone had a voice without judgement during discussions even if the rest of the class didn't agree.

The one person who left a bad rating obviously put zero effort in this class, because this professor is amazing. He's super chill and his lectures are so interesting. He's an awesome guy and cares about what his students are learning, one of my favorite professors. Take him if you want to have a good school semester.

I took this course over the summer and it was easy overall! There are lots of short writing assignments and discussion posts, but it's all really self explanatory. Professor Lemmons seemed super nice and caring, although I didn't have any interaction with him other than his announcements. The group project is super easy, just knock it out early!

Professor Lemmons is only picky about attendance, as long as a specific amount of students from your group show up then everyone in the group is counted present. If not then you get points off. Group tests, group presentations, group term paper (10 pgs), and 1 individual short essay. Take him for easy A! He's funny and jokes in class a lot.

Professor Lemmons is really funny and makes lectures entertaining. It is a group class but as long as 3 people from your group show up, attendance doesn't matter. Tests are very easy and there is one final paper you can work on as a group or alone. Take this class if you need an easy A and want to take an interesting class!

I LOVE this man! I was really nervous to take public speaking (I was required to) and I was definitely put outside my comfort zone with this class but in the best way possible. Getting an A is possible as long as you're willing to improve and show that you really want it. 70% of your final grade is from 4 speeches, other 30% are basically freebies!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: my fav professor at TAMU. the class itself is hard though and the majority of your grade is over individual presentations in the class. I was NOT a good public speaker but he teaches you how to get better. he is so funny and makes lots of jokes. TAKE HIM
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor is amazing, he cares about your grade and this is the type of class you wont want to miss bc it's so interesting. He is a really good person.
Dude is awesome, needed to miss class so I could go to math tutoring and he let me slide. Work hard and youll make an A. Cant get caught slacking though.

BEST prof I've ever had, it's his first year teaching at TAMU! He's super funny & laid back. Students pick groups & he takes attendance by group so as long as one person in your group is present youre good. All projects are group projects which you can get bonus points on, all tests are open note & you can take them with your group! no homework!
